crossRefs.note: Then came there to him all his brothers, and all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before…
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

translations.web: Did I say, ‘Give to me?’ or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance?’
translations.bsb: Have I ever said, ‘Give me something; offer me a bribe from your wealth;
translations.kjv: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
translations.asv: Did I say, Give unto me? Or, Offer a present for me of your substance?
